_doc.zh: 软组织材料表。每个数值要么带出处（sources 里的键、所在表格、测试方法、适用的应变范围），要么标 assumption: true。求解器用三样东西：小应变的 E、ν（稳定 neo-Hookean 能量），应变硬化系数 stiffening（κ，四次项），以及一个快的 Maxwell 支路（branchRatio、branchTau）。E 取的是秒量级的准静态响应。
_doc.en: Soft-tissue material table. Every number either has a source (a key of `sources`, the table, the test method and the strain range) or is marked assumption: true. The solver uses three things: small-strain E and ν (stable neo-Hookean energy), a strain-stiffening coefficient `stiffening` (κ, a quartic term) and one fast Maxwell branch (`branchRatio`, `branchTau`). E is the quasi-static response on a time scale of seconds.

model.energy: Ψ = μ/2·c + μκ/4·c² + Σ_n K_n/2·(J̄_n − 1)², c = I_C + J² − 4J (= I₁ − 3 when incompressible); nodal-average volume term (Bonet & Burton 1998); see src/softbody/solver.ts

stiffening.zh: κ 是 Yeoh 型二阶项：C₂₀ = μκ/4。由 Mooney–Rivlin 的 C₁₁ 换算：不可压小应变时 (I₁−3)(I₂−3) ≈ (I₁−3)²，故 κ = 2·C₁₁/C₁₀。由一阶 Ogden（Ψ = c/m²·Σ(λᵢᵐ − 1)，μ = c/2）换算：把两种能量按对数应变展开到四阶、在单轴不可压变形下对齐四阶项，得 κ ≈ m²/24 − 1/6。两种换算都是本项目的推导，只在中等应变（c ≲ 0.5）内近似成立；Ogden 的三阶项（拉压不对称）没有对应。
stiffening.en: κ is a Yeoh-type second-order term: C₂₀ = μκ/4. From the C₁₁ of a Mooney–Rivlin fit: (I₁−3)(I₂−3) ≈ (I₁−3)² for small incompressible strain, hence κ = 2·C₁₁/C₁₀. From a first-order Ogden fit (Ψ = c/m²·Σ(λᵢᵐ − 1), μ = c/2): expanding both energies in logarithmic strain to fourth order and matching the fourth-order terms in incompressible uniaxial deformation gives κ ≈ m²/24 − 1/6. Both conversions are this project's derivation and hold approximately at moderate strain only (c ≲ 0.5); the third-order term of Ogden (tension–compression asymmetry) has no counterpart.

viscoelasticity.zh: 每种材料一个 Maxwell 支路，取 forearm2026 表 4 的 Prony 级数里最快的一项。该文在静力分析里没有启用 Prony 项，而表里的超弹性参数直接拟合了 0.5 mm/s、历时约 6 s 的压入，所以这里把表里的模量当作 t ≈ 6 s 时的松弛模量 G(6 s)，支路模量与它之比 = g₁ / (1 − Σ gᵢ·(1 − e^{−6/τᵢ}))。这个解释是本项目的假设（assumption）。较慢的项（τ ≥ 2.5 s）没有模拟：保持数秒以上的应力松弛不会出现。
viscoelasticity.en: One Maxwell branch per material, the fastest term of the Prony series of forearm2026 Table 4. That paper did not activate the Prony terms in its static analyses, and its hyperelastic parameters fit an indentation at 0.5 mm/s lasting about 6 s directly, so the tabulated moduli are taken here as the relaxation modulus at t ≈ 6 s, G(6 s), and the branch modulus over it is g₁ / (1 − Σ gᵢ·(1 − e^{−6/τᵢ})). This reading is this project's assumption. The slower terms (τ ≥ 2.5 s) are not simulated: stress relaxation in holds of seconds or more does not appear.

note.zh: 相对速度的指数衰减率，没有出处。第二阶段有了 Maxwell 支路提供与速率有关的耗散，这一项降到 2/s，只用来消掉不带支路的材料（脂肪、乳房）里剩下的振荡。
note.en: Exponential decay rate of the relative velocity; unsourced. With the Maxwell branch of phase 2 supplying rate-dependent dissipation this is lowered to 2/s and only removes what oscillation is left in materials without a branch (fat, breast).

why.zh: forearm2026 筛选了三种脂肪模型：该文的 Fat2 就是这一组（它引 Mihai 等 2015）。含 Fat2 的组合在 P1 拟合最好（Skin2–Fat2，R² = 0.972），在 P3 也最好（Skin2–Fat2–Muscle3，R² = 0.983，峰值力误差 0.044，表 10）；第二阶段用的 Fat1（neo-Hookean μ = 0.53 kPa）在 P1 和 P2 都落在实验曲线之下（表 7、8：Skin2–Fat1 在 P1 峰值力误差 0.759，Skin2–Fat1–Muscle3 在 P2 为 0.352）。脂肪在压缩下强烈变硬，单个 κ 的四次项拟合不了（最小二乘把 κ 推到上限仍差 30%），所以求解器加了 Ogden 型偏量能。
why.en: forearm2026 screened three fat models; its Fat2 is this set (it cites Mihai et al. 2015). Fat2 combinations fitted best at P1 (Skin2–Fat2, R² = 0.972) and at P3 (Skin2–Fat2–Muscle3, R² = 0.983, peak-force error 0.044, Table 10); Fat1 of phase 2 (neo-Hookean μ = 0.53 kPa) stays below the measured curves at P1 and P2 (Tables 7 and 8: Skin2–Fat1 peak-force error 0.759 at P1, Skin2–Fat1–Muscle3 0.352 at P2). Fat stiffens strongly in compression, which a single quartic κ cannot fit (least squares drives κ to its bound and still misses by 30 %), so the solver gained an Ogden-type deviatoric energy.

discrepancy.zh: forearm2026 表 4 印的是 C = {2.34, 4.08, −0.42, 1.34} kPa，第四项的符号与 Mihai 原文（−1337 Pa）相反；按印出的符号 Σ C_p·m_p = −5.26 kPa（不稳定），所以这里用原文。该文实际在 Abaqus 里用了哪一组，打开的文字里看不出。
discrepancy.en: Table 4 of forearm2026 prints C = {2.34, 4.08, −0.42, 1.34} kPa, the sign of the fourth term opposite to Mihai's original (−1337 Pa); with the printed sign Σ C_p·m_p = −5.26 kPa (unstable), so the original is used here. Which set that paper actually ran in Abaqus cannot be told from the text opened.

strainRange.zh: Mihai 等拟合的是 3.5% 剪切叠加最多 40% 压缩或拉伸的数据；更大的应变是外推。
strainRange.en: Mihai et al. fitted data of 3.5 % shear superposed on up to 40 % compression or tension; larger strains are an extrapolation.

status.zh: 没有启用（第三阶段的试算）：在本模型的前臂上它让压入力更低（3.2 mm 时 0.673 N，Fat1 为 0.909 N，实测 1.43 N）；小应变时它比 Fat1 软 5.5 倍，压到 20% 才与 Fat1 相当。要用时在 MixOptions.ogden 里按材料 id 给出这一组。
status.en: Not active (a phase-3 trial): on this model's forearm it lowers the indentation force (0.673 N at 3.2 mm against 0.909 N with Fat1; measured 1.43 N); at small strain it is 5.5 times softer than Fat1 and matches it only at about 20 % compression. To use it, pass this set by material id in MixOptions.ogden.

remus2024.citation: Remus R, et al. Soft tissue material properties based on human abdominal in vivo macro-indenter measurements. Front Bioeng Biotechnol 2024. doi:10.3389/fbioe.2024.1384062
remus2024.opened: full text XML: sections 2.2 (indenter), 2.7–2.8 (FE model, Ogden energy), Tables 2, 4 and 6

note.zh: 十名健康男性（25–37 岁），半球形压头（半径 10 mm），进给 5 ± 1 mm/s；反演模型是半径和高都为 110 mm 的均质圆柱。
note.en: Ten healthy males (25–37 years), hemispherical tip (radius 10 mm), feed 5 ± 1 mm/s; the inverse model is a homogeneous cylinder with radius and height 110 mm.

mihai2015.citation: Mihai LA, Chin L, Janmey PA, Goriely A. A comparison of hyperelastic constitutive models applicable to brain and fat tissues. J R Soc Interface 2015;12:20150486. doi:10.1098/rsif.2015.0486
mihai2015.opened: full text XML: the model table (Ogden strain-energy form), the μ0 formula, Table 4 (lean fat)

note.zh: 离体人脂肪（瘦人）在 3.5% 剪切叠加压缩/拉伸下的剪切模量拟合。
note.en: Fits to the shear modulus of excised human fat (lean) under 3.5 % shear superposed on compression or tension.

_doc.zh: 求解器里不是材料常数、但会影响结果的数。都没有文献出处，是本项目定的；各自在哪个解析算例上定的写在 note 里。
_doc.en: Numbers in the solver that are not material constants but affect results. None has a literature source; all are set by this project, and each note says on which analytic case.

note.zh: 结点体积约束刚度比 h²·w‖∇C‖²·K 的上限；悬臂梁算例里 4 稳定、8 发散，取 2。超过上限的结点体积模量被压低（等效泊松比变小），所以单元细、子步少时结果仍随子步数变化。
note.en: Upper bound of the stiffness ratio h²·w‖∇C‖²·K of nodal volume constraints; in the cantilever case 4 was stable and 8 diverged, so 2 is used. Nodes above it get a lower bulk modulus (a smaller effective Poisson ratio), so with fine cells and few substeps results still depend on the substep count.

note.zh: 单元体积比的硬下限 J ≥ 0.3（应变极限），防止压头把单元压穿。
note.en: Hard floor J ≥ 0.3 of the element volume ratio (a strain limit), so a probe cannot push through an element.

note.zh: 几乎全在体外的四面体的刚度折减系数下限（质量的下限是 0.03）。
note.en: Floor of the stiffness fill factor of tetrahedra almost wholly outside the body (the floor for mass is 0.03).

note.zh: 平头压头参与接触的半径缩小 0.25 个单元；在半空间解析算例上标定（见 validation-report.json 的 numerics.pressOnBlock）。
note.en: The contact radius of a flat punch is reduced by 0.25 of a cell; calibrated on the half-space analytic case (numerics.pressOnBlock in validation-report.json).

note.zh: press() 力控时轴线压应变超过 0.6 就不再加深，返回带标记的结果。
note.en: In force control press() goes no deeper once the axial compressive strain passes 0.6 and returns a flagged result.

note.zh: 骨穿过的四面体里锚点的刚度，φ 是骨占四面体的体积比例；本项目的假设（src/softbody/body.ts）。
note.en: Stiffness of the anchor in a tetrahedron crossed by bone, φ being the bone share of the tetrahedron; this project's assumption (src/softbody/body.ts).

note.zh: press() 的有效性标记用的范围：45 kPa 约为 remus2024 放松腹部最大力 13.3 N 除以半径 10 mm 压头的投影面积；应变 0.4 是本模型四次项近似还说得过去的上限。
note.en: The range behind the validity flags of press(): 45 kPa is about the largest relaxed-abdomen force of remus2024, 13.3 N, over the projected area of its 10 mm tip; a strain of 0.4 is where the quartic approximation of this model stops being defensible.
